open_points.subject: R0-96 owner instruction
open_points.text: The owner learns the rule from the governance; the owner interface does not show it.
open_points.question: What concrete action ensures that the owner receives and acknowledges the room-name and alias rule before writing either value, and what happens if that action has not occurred?
options: Governance requires a recorded acknowledgement before production use
Governance publishes the rule and assumes the owner has read it
Another owner-facing mechanism presents the rule outside Registry
open_points.default_guess: Treat the governance document as sufficient instruction, with no acknowledgement or technical failure.

witness.initial: The owner can use the owner interface but has not read the relevant governance rule.
events: The owner creates a room or assigns an alias containing a person's name, address, condition, health or needs.
Registry accepts the value because it checks no content.
The value reaches the agent through its projection.
outcomes: A governance process prevents use until the owner has received or acknowledged the rule.
No process intervenes; publication of the governance text alone counts as learning the rule.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent receiving the value

open_points.subject: R0-96 first-release agent instruction
open_points.text: until then the rule binds the owner, and the agent through the governance's instructions to it.
open_points.question: During the first release, who turns the governance rule into instructions the agent actually receives, through what system or trust boundary, at what point in a session or run, and what observable failure occurs if those instructions are absent or stale?
options: Cabinet Kernel injects the rule into every agent run
Cabinet or another platform component supplies it when creating the agent session
The owner manually instructs the agent
The agent is assumed to consult governance without a delivery mechanism
open_points.default_guess: Have Cabinet Kernel inject the current governance rule into every agent run and refuse agent room or alias writes when that instruction set is unavailable.

witness.initial: The first release is running, so the manifest description has not yet been changed.
events: Kernel starts an agent run that can add a room.
No text specifies which component loads the governance instruction into that run.
The agent proposes a room name describing a person's health need.
outcomes: The run contains the governance instruction, so the agent avoids the prohibited name.
The run does not contain it, so the agent writes the name; Registry accepts it and later returns it to agents.
witness.observer: The owner approving the write and agents that read the room name
